input.events: Entire chronological event sequence available before computation; valid endpoints
input.copies: Repeated adds increase multiplicity; remove consumes one copy; edge live until last copy removed

output.answers: vector<bool> in query occurrence order; query(v,v) true; no queries => empty

constraints.errors: Remove of inactive edge, unknown event kind invalid_argument; invalid ID out_of_range; storage overflow length_error; allocation may throw
constraints.deletion_scope: Supports remove events only in this offline batch; no online delete API
constraints.undo_scope: Internal rollback not exposed as user rollback/redo
constraints.threading: Independent calls only; returned vector<bool> concurrent writes unsafe

complexity.preprocess: O(q*log(q+1) + K*log(q+1)) where K is live intervals
complexity.space: O(n+q+K*log(q+1)); input, allocator/map overhead and output also matter

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: BFS oracle at each query across valid randomized multigraph event streams; repeated edges and invalid removal

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
provenance.license: Project distribution license not yet selected
